svg.title: AURA-CV: integrity checks for computer-vision pipelines, fully air-gapped
svg.desc: Architecture sketch: contributed dataset / trained model / inference records → check plugins → findings + disposition → hash-chained audit log. Built with Python, Pydantic, cryptography, rfc8785, Typer, React, Three.js.
